_comment: Synth runtime MCP server registry. SEPARATE from .mcp.json (which is DEV-ONLY tooling for Claude Code / Copilot). Servers listed here are consumed by Synth's own MCP client bridge (core/mcp_bridge) at runtime. Add/remove entries to give Synth external tool access. Set 'enabled': false to disable without removing.

synth_logs.description: Runtime log analysis MCP server shipped with Synth.

synth_llm_failures.description: Structured access to the persisted llm_failure_log table (same data as the WebUI Logs page). Pair with synth_logs to cross-reference structured failures against raw runtime logs.

filesystem.description: Local filesystem access for Synth (repo + logs roots). DISABLED: the runtime image (python:3.12-slim) has NO node/npx (node exists only in the Dockerfile 'stage_builder' build stage), so 'npx @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem' cannot start in-container. The roots are ${SYNTH_MCP_FS_ROOT:-/app} based so a non-container deployment can point them at its own checkout with one env var instead of editing this file. Re-enable only after adding a node runtime to the image. For sandboxed file writing, Synth uses the native 'agent_write_file' action in plugins/agent_plugin.py instead (no node dependency).

_placeholder_help: Paths here MUST work in every deployment of this repo, and they do not share a layout: the Docker image runs from /app with its interpreter at /app/venv/bin/python, a Windows checkout has .venv\Scripts\python.exe. So use placeholders instead of literal paths, in 'command', 'args', 'env' values and 'url': {python} = the interpreter running Synth (sys.executable); {repo_root} = the root of this checkout; {log_dir} = the effective LOG_DIR of this process; ${VAR} and ${VAR:-default} = environment references. A literal path is still allowed and is used as written; an unknown {placeholder} is left in place and logged as a warning at load time.
